page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.r7.8xlarge is a memory-optimized virtual machine instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 32 dedicated physical cores on an x86_64 architecture, utilizing Intel Xeon 8369B processors running at a base clock speed of 2.7 GHz. The instance is equipped with 256.0 GB of RAM, providing a high memory-to-vCPU ratio of 8.0 GB per core. It does not include local storage or GPU accelerators, relying entirely on network-attached storage and featuring a baseline network bandwidth of 16 Gbps.

Benchmark data indicates solid mid-range performance across standard compute and memory tasks. The instance achieved a Geekbench multi-core score of 13384.0 and a Passmark CPU score of 35326.14. Memory performance is characterized by a read-only large-block bandwidth of 141.73 GB/sec and a write large-block bandwidth of 65.94 GB/sec. In database operations, the server processed 30.13 million Redis SET operations per second. For lightweight language model tasks, it demonstrated strong text generation speeds of 282.15 tokens per second with a 135M model, though performance scales down to 17.54 tokens per second for a 7B model.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the ecs.r7.8xlarge offers high memory density relative to its compute resources, making it a viable option for memory-bound workloads without paying for unnecessary CPU overhead. However, the complete absence of local storage means users must factor in the latency and cost of external block storage. This instance is highly suited for memory-intensive applications, including relational databases, in-memory caching systems like Redis, enterprise resource planning software, and large-scale data processing tasks.
